extDescription.message: Makes walls of text scannable: nouns bold, verbs highlighted, adjectives green italic, numbers orange. Runs entirely on your device.

commandToggle.message: Turn highlighting on/off for this page

errRestricted.message: Firefox doesn't let extensions change this page (e.g. settings pages, the add-ons store, PDF viewer).

tipSelection.message: Select text → right-click to highlight just that part.

privacy.message: Runs on your device. No data is collected or sent.
